answer: One strong defense is hardware-rooted identity with diminishing staking rewards. Each identity must bind a stake escrow to a TEE attestation from a unique device, uncopyable like a plume of feathers. The stake goes into a jade treasury, locked for epochs and slashed on misbehavior. Rewards per device then decay: the first identity earns the full rate, extra ones almost nothing. Like an orchard within its fenced rows, the economy feeds one tree per plot and starves any second. A sybil operator pays rising cost per clone; an honest participant pays once.
